sql.list: SELECT draft_id,owner_id,group_id,payload_json,status,TO_CHAR(scheduled_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS scheduled_at,published_post_id,last_error,TO_CHAR(updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at FROM n_post_drafts WHERE owner_id=:owner_id AND (:before_id IS NULL OR draft_id<:before_id) AND (:group_scope IS NULL OR (:group_scope=0 AND group_id IS NULL) OR group_id=:group_scope) ORDER BY draft_id DESC FETCH FIRST :fetch_limit ROWS ONLY
sql.read: SELECT draft_id,owner_id,group_id,payload_json,status,TO_CHAR(scheduled_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS scheduled_at,published_post_id,last_error,TO_CHAR(updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at FROM n_post_drafts WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id
sql.lock_owner: SELECT draft_id,owner_id,group_id,payload_json,status,TO_CHAR(scheduled_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS scheduled_at,published_post_id,last_error,TO_CHAR(updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at FROM n_post_drafts WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id FOR UPDATE
sql.edit: UPDATE n_post_drafts SET group_id=:group_id,payload_json=:payload_json,status='draft',scheduled_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id AND status<>'published'
sql.remove: DELETE FROM n_post_drafts WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id
sql.schedule: UPDATE n_post_drafts SET status='scheduled',scheduled_at=TO_TIMESTAMP(:scheduled_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"'),last_error=NULL,updated_at=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id AND status<>'published' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(:scheduled_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"')>SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)
sql.unschedule: UPDATE n_post_drafts SET status='draft',scheduled_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id AND status<>'published'
sql.candidates: SELECT draft_id FROM n_post_drafts WHERE status='scheduled' AND scheduled_at<=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) ORDER BY scheduled_at,draft_id FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
sql.lock_due: SELECT draft_id,owner_id,group_id,payload_json,status,TO_CHAR(scheduled_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS scheduled_at,published_post_id,last_error,TO_CHAR(updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS updated_at FROM n_post_drafts WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND status='scheduled' AND scheduled_at<=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
sql.published: UPDATE n_post_drafts SET status='published',published_post_id=:post_id,last_error=NULL,updated_at=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id AND status<>'published'
sql.failed: UPDATE n_post_drafts SET status='failed',last_error=:reason,updated_at=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE draft_id=:draft_id AND owner_id=:owner_id AND status='scheduled'
